summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Signature Studio v2 (owner/manager RBAC, forgot/reset password, team invites, featured, categories, lightbox, share menu). Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. Frontend: home has only Owner Access link (no Create Account), /setup redirects to /, login shows Forgot Password link, wrong password shows 'Email or password is incorrect', owner login redirects to /admin, OWNER badge visible in header, WORKS/NICHES/TEAM tabs render, create category via UI works, invite modal opens with all fields (email/name/role/send), forgot-password submit shows success, /reset-password without token shows reset-missing-token, lightbox opens on portfolio card click and closes with Escape, share menu shows WhatsApp/Email/Copy Link with correct hrefs, featured badge renders and featured item ordered first.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal backdrop does not close on Escape key press (invite modal stays open, blocks logout button underneath). Users can still click the X to close, but Escape key handler is missing.

action_items: Optional: add Escape-key handler to InviteModal (and any other modal-backdrop) to dismiss the dialog for keyboard users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py send_email raises HTTPException 502 on Resend failure but forgot-password endpoint catches only HTTPException; still returns {ok:true} so no data leak — good.

invite_member() catches HTTPException from send_invite_email but ANY non-HTTP exception (network, DNS) would 500 the endpoint AND leave the invitation + user row created. Consider broader except around send_invite_email or transactional rollback.
TTL indexes are created on both invitations and password_reset_tokens (verified via mongosh).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 featured Design portfolio item in 'Hotel & Resort' and 1 UITEST category via UI; both cleaned up. Backend tests create & clean their own TEST_ prefixed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 requested features verified. Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/test_signature_studio_api.py covers register-removed, login, forgot/reset flow (via mongosh token lookup), TTL index existence, unauth 401s, portfolio CRUD + featured ordering, category CRUD + hidden public visibility, category-with-works delete 400, team list, invite, owner-cannot-self-demote/disable/remove, and MANAGER role enforcement (403 on /admin/team, 200 on /admin/portfolio). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env; must be set when invoking pytest.
